title: Editing a scheduled email takes it off the schedule, so nothing sends that an approver did not see

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system)

detail:
Only an approver (admin or janitor) can schedule or send an Email Studio campaign, but saveEmailCampaign (writer gated, the per-keystroke autosave) updated the row by id alone. A content writer could change the subject, body, From name, reply mode or purpose of a scheduled campaign, and /api/cron/space-campaigns would send the new version. The phase approval spine (assertApproved) never applied: all 17 production campaigns have phase_id null on 2026-11-19.

DONE 2026-11-19: lib/email-studio/edit-lock.ts editLockFor decides open / disarm / locked. The autosave reads it before any write. A scheduled email is moved back to draft with no send time (approval_status ready/approved/scheduled reset to draft) before the edit lands, and the call answers { unscheduled: true }. Sending, paused, sent, or a failed send that already queued people is refused with no write. Every content write re-asserts status in (draft, cancelled, failed), so a schedule or cron claim racing the save never picks up unreviewed content. Tests: actions.test.ts (approved+scheduled edit disarms first, cron race, locked states, failed with and without recipients, draft-to-scheduled race) and edit-lock.test.ts. Follow-ups: the editor does not yet show a notice when an edit unschedules (it reads as Draft on reload); approval bound to a content fingerprint is EMAIL-086.

verify.note: Passes while the autosave reads the edit lock first, disarms a scheduled email and resets approval, refuses one going out, and guards every content write by status.
